title: RawTelegramEventMessage
description: Unprocessed Telegram message event published to the raw_events RabbitMQ exchange by the telegram-scraper service. Extends RawOsintEventMessage.

event_type.description: Classified event type. Note: 'missle_hit' is the canonical spelling used in the codebase.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat ID. Can be negative for groups and supergroups.

channel_main_lang.description: BCP-47 language code of the channel, e.g. 'he' for Hebrew.

msg_id.description: Telegram message ID within the channel.
